integrity: Self-contained analytic derivation from the cohort wealth equation; no numerical approximation is used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The obstruction assumes a stationary smooth age-density flow, bounded constant income, bounded nonnegative consumption, and a uniformly bounded interest rate.
It rules out a single lifespan and rate bound uniform over all positive \(C^1\) capital profiles; it does not rule out a \(K\)-dependent existence theorem.
title: A uniformity obstruction for equilibrium rates under arbitrary capital-supply paths
